nodes.name: NiFe LDH Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: For NiFe LDH structures, 0.75 mmol of Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O (Nickel(II) nitrate hexahydrate, Sigma-Aldrich, 94.5-105.5 %) and 0.25 mmol of Fe(NO₃)₃·9H₂O (Iron(III) nitrate nonahydrate, Alfa Aesar, ACS, 98.0-101.0 %) were dissolved by stirring for 5 h in 30 mL solutions of different ratios of de-ionized (DI) water (18.2 MΩ) and ethanol (Ethyl alcohol, Fisher Scientific, 99.9% 10:0,7:3,5:5,3:7,and 0:10 denoted as W-only, WE 73, WE 55, WE 37, and E-only respectively). 0.8 mmol of Na₂CO₃ (Sodium carbonate, Sigma-Aldrich, ≥99.5% ACS reagent) and 70 μL of NaOH (Sodium hydroxide, Sigma-Aldrich, reagent grade, 97 %) solutions at pH 13 were added to the metal salt solutions by stirring for 30 min. The mixed solution was transferred to a Teflon autoclave and heated at 120°C for 12 h After heating, the resulting precipitate was washed with DI water and ethanol several times and dried in a vacuum oven at 50°C overnight. Powder-type catalysts were obtained by grinding the dried samples.
